interactions.note: The epitope of 5D3 Fab on the multidrug ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporter ABCG2 with estrone-3-sulfate (E1S) bound was determined from the single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) reconstruction of the complex at 3.58Å resolution. The catalytic glutamate E211 was replaced with a glutamine, resulting in greatly reduced, but not abolished ATP hydrolysis and E1S transport activity.
interactions.target_name: Broad substrate specificity ATP-binding cassette transporter ABCG2

interactions.target_raw: Broad substrate specificity ATP-binding cassette transporter ABCG2
interactions.note: The epitope of 5D3 Fab on the multidrug ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporter ABCG2 was determined from the single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) reconstruction of the complex at 3.78Å resolution. Negative-stain EM revealed that two 5D3-Fab fragments bound to a single, nanodisc-reconstituted ABCG2 homodimer. The resulting ABCG2–5D3(Fab) complex had a molecular mass of ~250 kDa and maintained two-fold symmetry. [PDB: 5NJG] represents the de novo built structure of the ABCG2 TMD in complex with 5D3-Fab variable domain.

The resulting ABCG2–5D3(Fab) complex had a molecular mass of ~250 kDa and maintained two-fold symmetry. [PDB: 5NJG] represents the de novo built structure of the ABCG2 TMD in complex with 5D3-Fab variable domain.
